# !!! VERIFY THIS TABLE AGAINST YOUR OWN ARCHIVE BEFORE TRUSTING IT !!!
# Kruti Dev ships in many variants (010, 011, 016, 050, ...) whose ligature
# slots differ. This table encodes the common Remington-layout 010 mapping.
# Run `latters fonts gold` after adding ~200 hand-verified pairs from your
# real letters; anything wrong here shows up immediately as a failing pair.
# Matching is maximal-munch (longest legacy string wins), so entry order in
# this file does not matter -- the loader sorts by length descending.
# Two legacy characters are NOT literal and are handled by reordering passes
# in convert.py, not by this table alone:
#   f  -> U+093F chhoti-i matra, stored BEFORE its cluster, must move after
#   Z  -> reph, stored AFTER its cluster, must become U+0930 U+094D before it
# They appear below with their naive Unicode value; convert.py fixes position.

column1: # Full-consonant form of the half-sa key. `L` alone is स्; `Lk` is स, not
# स् + ा, which would be invalid Devanagari. Evidenced 46 times as Lkkj.k
# -> सारण. The same pattern probably holds for other half-form keys;
# do not add those without the same kind of evidence.
#--- systematic completion: <half-form key> + k = the FULL consonant -------
# The Remington layout gives every consonant a half form on the shifted key;
# adding `k` to it yields the full consonant, NOT half + aa-matra. Half form
# followed by an aa-matra is illegal Devanagari in every case, so these
# entries can only be an improvement -- maximal munch takes the two-character
# form and the one-character half form still applies everywhere else.
# The rest were missing, which is why `Ik=kad` (101 occurrences in a real
# archive) converted to प्ात्रांक instead of पत्रांक.
# `kW` is a single unit, not aa-matra followed by candra-o. Typing MkW means
# डॉ, not डाॉ; vkWuykbZu is ऑनलाइन, not आॉनलाईन. 215 occurrences in the
# sample archive, all of them English loanwords.

column3: candra-o matra after a consonant (MkW0 -> डॉ०)

column1: # The independent vowel needs its own three-character slot: maximal munch
# scans left to right, so in `vkWuykbZu` the two-character `vk` matches at
# position 0 and wins before `kW` can be seen at position 1, giving आॉ
# instead of ऑ. ऑ (U+0911) is a precomposed vowel, not अ + ॉ.
